faqs.q: Do I need an adviser, or can I apply myself?
faqs.a: You can apply directly to the Home Office. Many people use us because a missing document or a misunderstood requirement can mean a refusal, a lost fee and months of delay. We make sure your application is complete before it's submitted.

faqs.q: How much do your services cost?
faqs.a: Our fee depends on the visa route and is agreed before we start. Home Office fees and the Immigration Health Surcharge are paid separately. [Add example prices or a link to your fees page.]

faqs.q: Do I need to come to your Manchester office?
faqs.a: No. You can meet us at 61 Mosley Street, or we can work with you by phone, video call and email from anywhere in the UK.
Yes. Unique Visa Services Ltd is registered with the Immigration Advice Authority, reference F200700144. You can check this on the IAA's adviser finder.
